name: Devotion David
tagline: Bring a theme, get passages from the tradition you name to sit with today
description: A quiet-time companion for daily use, built around a theme rather than a doctrine. Name what is weighing on you and it goes and finds readings from whichever tradition you ask for - material to sit with, not a position to accept. Your practice stays yours: no pushing, no proselytizing, just the text.
author: FrankFindsOut
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
